name: pcp
description: Pre-call prep: one-time calibration saved per user, public-source OSINT/SOCMINT with a coverage ledger, a six-dimension behavioral read, and ONE 3-page PDF (2-page brief + 1-page meeting script). Every fact cited.

interface.shortDescription: One cited 3-page brief and meeting script before any call
interface.longDescription: Calibrates once, then researches the person, company or deal you are about to meet from public sources only, writes a coverage ledger, reads six behavioural dimensions from cited evidence, and renders one 3-page PDF: a 2-page brief and a 1-page meeting script. Every fact carries a source.
defaultPrompt: Prep me for my call with Jane Doe at Acme Capital.
